1 T local honey 1 cup nonfat plain Greek yogurt 1 cup cauliflower 1 cup spinach 1 peeled lemon 1 cup frozen mango

Put honey and 2 Tbl water in a bowl and microwave 20 sec to dissolve honey.

In a food proccessor or blender add yogurt, and melted honey. Blend until the honey is evenly mixed into the yogurt.

Add cauliflower, spinach, lemon, and frozen mango. Blend until smooth.

Makes one large or two small smoothies. Note that there is a lot of grams of sugar in here from the honey and mango.
